system.description: You can use your mastery of Sith Alchemy to create mutated abominations. You must have access to a willing (or unconscious) creature to which you will apply the Sith Abomination Template or the Chrysalis Beast Template. You also need a medical lab outfitted for the process, which requires a number of days equal to creature's modified CL. You must spend a Force Point at the completion of the process to complete the transformation. A creature you have mutated is considered to be a domesticated creature, but for you only (unless it was already a domesticated creature before its mutation).

prerequisite.text: Sith Alchemy (Sith Alchemy Talent Tree) talent
